title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Hover and Ctrl+click on a catalog accessor got slower two releases ago. They are now faster than before either change.

highlights.title: Catalog Hover And Ctrl Click Speed
highlights.description: Trying every catalog root rebuilt the search pattern on every call, on a path that runs at every mouse move. Alternating measurements: 34.9 ms before, 59.7 ms as shipped, 23.9 ms now, with no overlap between the three.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Trying every catalog root, added in the previous release, rebuilt the search pattern on every call, and these run on every mouse move over a build file. Measured by alternating passes against the two earlier builds so machine drift cancels out: 34.9 ms before, 59.7 ms as shipped, 23.9 ms now, with the three sets of readings not overlapping at all. The pattern is now built once per catalog name and shared, which also removes a rebuild that Ctrl+click was already paying before any of this.
The list of catalogs and their names is now computed when a catalog file changes rather than on every lookup.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No visible change other than speed. No new commands or settings.
